title: armeria maritima var. soleirolii
intro: Armeria maritima var. soleirolii, commonly known as Sea Thrift, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote healing. The therapeutic actions of Sea Thrift include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Armeria maritima var. soleirolii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
